, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to dance. She would dance all day long. One day, Sue wanted to go to the dance with her friends.
Sue and her friends got ready to go. They put on their best clothes and went to the dance. Sue was very excited. She could not wait to see the dance.
When it was Sue's turn, she danced in the big, noisy dance. Her friends laughed and clapped. Sue was so happy. She danced and danced until the sun went down. Sue and her friends had the best day ever.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her friends in the park. One day, she saw a man with a big bag of candy. Lucy wanted the candy, so she took a big bag of candy and ran away.
Lucy ran fast and saw a man in a uniform. She went to the man and said, "Please, can I have some candy? I am very hungry." The man looked at Lucy and said, "I will give you some candy, but you must help me first."
Lucy agreed, and the man gave her some candy. But then, something unexpected happened. The candy turned into a big, colorful ball! The man was very surprised. The ball said, "Now, I will change you back into a little girl." The man turned the candy back into a little girl, and Lucy was happy. Lucy learned that being good is more important than being pretty and strong like her new friend.
